title: 第17章 人间绝色第18章 血毒
lines: 月光下。
许辰眼睛逐渐瞪大。
眨也不眨看着前方大树下。
那里，一个身穿长裙的女人，背靠着大树，双眼微闭，仿佛靠着树睡着了一样。
但是。
月光下，苍白的脸，让人知道，她并非睡着了，而是伤势太重从而昏死了过去。
“咕嘟！”
许辰咽了口唾沫。
念什么来什么。
这个女人，不是别人，正是那与血护法厮杀的红裙女人。
看样子红裙女人受伤不轻啊。
见到红裙女人，许辰内心不由松了口气。
接着。
他又犯难了。
救？
还是不救？
救了她的话，谁能保证，红裙女人伤势好转之后，会不会觊觎他的宝物，对他下杀手？
他身上资源之丰富，连真气境武者都要眼红的啊。
不救的话，红裙女人很可能会因伤势过重而死亡，或者被血护法找到，成为其恢复修为的‘养料’。
“诶～算了，谁让你救过我一命，就当还你人情吧。”
许辰走过去，蹲下身，把红裙女人抱了起来，双手不免触碰到女人的肌肤，柔软，滑腻，美妙极了。
许辰不由心神一荡。
低头看着怀中精致立体的瓜子脸，心中燥热。
猛地一咬舌尖，刺痛令许辰恢复清明，深吸一口气，压下心中的火气。
他很想给自己一个巴掌，这都什么时侯，竟然还能涌起别样心思。
抱着红裙女人，卖命般的向着远处狂奔而去。
一路狂奔。
直到再次力尽，前后加起来已经距离水府出世的地点七八十里了，许辰才彻底放下心来，把女人放在一边，自己因为疲惫，不知不觉就睡了过去。
不知过去多长时间。
许辰缓缓睁开了眼。
太阳已经升至头顶。
他歪头看向红裙女人的方向。
这一看，竟然没有看到红裙女人。
就在他疑惑之时，脖颈处忽然传来金属般冰冷的触感。
许辰心中一惊。
“别动！”
柔软中带着冰冷质感的声音，随之在耳畔响起。
许辰不敢妄动。
因为自己的小命此刻就在对方手中。
他循着声音看去。
看到的是一张略显苍白的俏脸。
content_en:
Under the moonlight.
Xu Chen's eyes gradually widened.
Without blinking, he looked ahead under the big tree.
There, a woman in a long skirt leaned against a big tree with her eyes slightly closed, as if she was asleep against the tree.
but.
Under the moonlight, her pale face made it known that she was not asleep, but was too seriously injured and passed out.
"Gudu!"
Xu Chen swallowed.
Whatever you read comes.
This woman was none other than the woman in the red dress who was fighting with the Blood Protector.
It looked like the woman in the red dress was seriously injured.
Seeing the woman in the red dress, Xu Chen couldn't help but feel relieved.
then.
He was in trouble again.
save?
Still not saving?
If he saves her, who can guarantee that after the woman in the red dress recovers from her injuries, she will covet his treasure and kill him?
He has so many resources that even Zhen Qi realm warriors would be jealous.
If she is not saved, the woman in the red dress is likely to die from her injuries, or be found by the Blood Protector, who will become the 'nourishment' for her to restore her cultivation.
"Hey~ forget it, whoever asked you to save my life, just treat it as a favor to you."
Xu Chen walked over, squatted down, and hugged the woman in the red dress. His hands inevitably touched the woman's skin, which was soft, smooth, and wonderful.
Xu Chen couldn't help but feel confused.
Looking down at the delicate three-dimensional oval face in his arms, he felt hot in his heart.
Biting the tip of his tongue suddenly, the stinging pain made Xu Chen regain his clarity. He took a deep breath to suppress the anger in his heart.
He wanted to give himself a slap, but at this time, he could have other thoughts.
Holding the woman in the red dress, she ran towards the distance as hard as she could.
Running all the way.
It wasn't until he was exhausted again, and the total distance between him and Shui Fu was already seventy or eighty miles away from the place where Shui Fu was born, that Xu Chen completely relaxed and put the woman aside. He fell asleep unknowingly because of exhaustion.
I don’t know how much time has passed.
Xu Chen slowly opened his eyes.
The sun was already high overhead.
He tilted his head and looked in the direction of the woman in the red dress.
When I looked at it, I didn't see the woman in the red dress.
Just when he was confused, a metallic cold touch suddenly came from his neck.
Xu Chen was shocked.
"Don't move!"
A soft voice with a cold texture sounded in his ears.
Xu Chen didn't dare to move rashly.
Because your life is in the other person's hands at this moment.
He followed the sound.
What he saw was a pretty, slightly pale face.
